# Rooms & devices

Room and device cards built with the entity group card's `row`, `column` and `table` layouts, the entity sections card and `header_entities` on the title line. The overview row uses badges and icon buttons, every room shows its climate in the header and its controls as tappable icons, and the device cards mix a table of facts with a footer of actions. Everything is interactive: toggle a light, start the vacuum, activate a scene.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 3
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Overview, icon: mdi:view-dashboard }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Who is home
      icon: mdi:account-group
      layout: row
      align: space-between
      entities:
        - entity: person.alex
          name: Alex
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: home, color: green, icon: mdi:account, label: Home }
            - { state: not_home, color: grey, icon: mdi:account-arrow-right, label: Away }
        - entity: person.sam
          name: Sam
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: home, color: green, icon: mdi:account, label: Home }
            - { state: not_home, color: grey, icon: mdi:account-arrow-right, label: Away }
        - entity: person.kim
          name: Kim
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: home, color: green, icon: mdi:account, label: Home }
            - { state: not_home, color: grey, icon: mdi:account-arrow-right, label: Away }
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Modes
      icon: mdi:toggle-switch-outline
      layout: row
      align: space-between
      entities:
        - entity: input_boolean.night_mode
          name: Night
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: indigo }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: input_boolean.guest_mode
          name: Guests
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: pink }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: input_boolean.away_mode
          name: Away
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: blue }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: input_boolean.vacation_mode
          name: Vacation
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: teal, tint_card: true }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Scenes
      icon: mdi:palette
      layout: row
      align: space-between
      entities:
        - entity: scene.bright
          name: Bright
          color: amber
          tap_action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: scene.turn_on, target: { entity_id: scene.bright } }
        - entity: scene.dimmed
          name: Dimmed
          color: orange
          tap_action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: scene.turn_on, target: { entity_id: scene.dimmed } }
        - entity: scene.dinner
          name: Dinner
          color: deep-orange
          tap_action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: scene.turn_on, target: { entity_id: scene.dinner } }
        - entity: scene.movie_night
          name: Movie
          color: deep-purple
          tap_action:
            action: perform-action
            perform_action: scene.turn_on
            target: { entity_id: scene.movie_night }
        - entity: scene.good_night
          name: Night
          color: indigo
          tap_action:
            action: perform-action
            perform_action: scene.turn_on
            target: { entity_id: scene.good_night }
      grid_options: { columns: 12 }
- column_span: 1
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Rooms, icon: mdi:floor-plan }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card
      title: Living room
      icon: mdi:sofa
      header_entities:
        - entity: sensor.living_room_temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 19, color: blue }
            - { below: 25, color: green }
            - { above: 25, color: orange }
        - { entity: sensor.living_room_humidity, decimals: 0 }
      sections:
        - layout: row
          show_name: false
          show_value: true
          entities:
            - entity: sensor.living_room_co2
              decimals: 0
              rules:
                - { below: 800, color: green }
                - { below: 1200, color: amber }
                - { above: 1200, color: red }
            - { entity: climate.living_room, icon: mdi:thermostat, color: orange, attribute: temperature, unit: °C }
            - { entity: media_player.living_room_tv, icon: mdi:television, color: green, attribute: media_title }
        - layout: row
          align: space-between
          show_name: false
          entities:
            - entity: light.living_room
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: amber }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
              tap_action: { action: toggle }
            - entity: light.dining_table
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: amber }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
              tap_action: { action: toggle }
            - entity: cover.living_room_blinds
              rules:
                - { state: open, color: green, icon: mdi:window-shutter-open }
                - { state: closed, color: grey, icon: mdi:window-shutter }
              tap_action:
                action: perform-action
                perform_action: cover.toggle
                target: { entity_id: cover.living_room_blinds }
            - entity: media_player.living_room_tv
              icon: mdi:television
              rules:
                - { state: playing, color: green }
                - { state: idle, color: grey }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
            - entity: vacuum.robot
              rules:
                - { state: cleaning, color: blue }
                - { state: docked, color: grey }
                - { state: returning, color: teal }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Kitchen
      icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife
      layout: row
      align: space-between
      header_entities:
        - { entity: sensor.kitchen_temperature, decimals: 1 }
        - { entity: sensor.kitchen_humidity, decimals: 0, show_icon: false }
      entities:
        - entity: light.kitchen
          name: Light
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: light.dining_table
          name: Dining
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: switch.coffee_machine
          name: Coffee
          icon: mdi:coffee-maker
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: brown }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
          name: Speaker
          icon: mdi:speaker
          rules:
            - { state: playing, color: green }
            - { state: idle, color: grey }
        - entity: sensor.dishwasher_status
          name: Dishes
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: run, color: green, label: Running }
            - { state: end, color: teal, label: Done }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          show_value: true
          show_icon: false
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card
      title: Office
      icon: mdi:desk
      sections:
        - layout: hero
          entities:
            - entity: sensor.office_temperature
              name: Temperature
              decimals: 1
              visual: sparkline
              rules:
                - { below: 19, color: blue, label: Cool }
                - { below: 24, color: green, label: Pleasant }
                - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
            - entity: sensor.office_co2
              name: CO₂
              decimals: 0
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { below: 800, color: green, label: Fresh }
                - { below: 1200, color: amber, label: Stuffy }
                - { above: 1200, color: red, label: Ventilate }
        - divider: true
          layout: row
          align: space-between
          name_position: below
          entities:
            - entity: light.office
              name: Ceiling
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: amber }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
              tap_action: { action: toggle }
            - entity: light.desk_lamp
              name: Desk
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: amber }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
              tap_action: { action: toggle }
            - entity: cover.office_blinds
              name: Blinds
              icon: mdi:window-shutter
              tap_action:
                action: perform-action
                perform_action: cover.toggle
                target: { entity_id: cover.office_blinds }
            - entity: binary_sensor.window_office
              name: Window
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open }
                - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed }
- column_span: 1
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: More rooms, icon: mdi:door }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Bedroom
      icon: mdi:bed
      layout: column
      show_name: false
      header_entities:
        - { entity: sensor.bedroom_temperature, decimals: 1 }
      entities:
        - entity: light.bedroom
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: cover.bedroom_blinds
          icon: mdi:window-shutter
          rules:
            - { state: open, color: green }
            - { state: closed, color: grey }
          tap_action:
            action: perform-action
            perform_action: cover.toggle
            target: { entity_id: cover.bedroom_blinds }
        - entity: climate.bedroom
          icon: mdi:thermostat
          rules:
            - { state: heat, color: orange }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_bedroom
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Bathroom
      icon: mdi:shower
      layout: row
      align: space-between
      show_value: true
      entities:
        - { entity: sensor.bathroom_temperature, name: Temperature, color: teal, decimals: 1 }
        - entity: sensor.bathroom_humidity
          name: Humidity
          decimals: 0
          rules:
            - { below: 60, color: green }
            - { below: 70, color: amber }
            - { above: 70, color: red }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_bathroom
          name: Window
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card
      title: Hallway
      icon: mdi:door
      sections:
        - layout: table
          show_icon: true
          entities:
            - entity: binary_sensor.door_front
              name: Front door
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:door-open, label: Open }
                - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:door-closed, label: Closed }
            - entity: binary_sensor.motion_hallway
              name: Motion
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: amber, icon: mdi:motion-sensor, label: Detected }
                - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:motion-sensor-off, label: Clear }
            - { entity: sensor.hallway_temperature, name: Temperature, decimals: 1 }
        - divider: true
          layout: row
          align: end
          show_name: false
          entities:
            - entity: light.hallway
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: amber }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
              tap_action: { action: toggle }
            - entity: script.check_windows
              icon: mdi:window-closed-variant
              color: blue
              tap_action:
                action: perform-action
                perform_action: script.turn_on
                target: { entity_id: script.check_windows }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Garden
      icon: mdi:flower
      layout: row
      align: stretch
      entities:
        - entity: light.garden
          name: Lights
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: switch.garden_pump
          name: Pump
          icon: mdi:water-pump
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: blue }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
        - entity: cover.awning
          name: Awning
          icon: mdi:storefront-outline
          rules:
            - { state: open, color: green }
            - { state: closed, color: grey }
        - entity: binary_sensor.rain
          name: Rain
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: blue, icon: mdi:weather-rainy }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:weather-cloudy }
- column_span: 1
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Devices, icon: mdi:devices }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card
      title: Robot vacuum
      icon: mdi:robot-vacuum
      header_entities:
        - entity: vacuum.robot
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: cleaning, color: blue, label: Cleaning }
            - { state: docked, color: green, label: Docked }
            - { state: returning, color: teal, label: Returning }
      sections:
        - layout: table
          entities:
            - { entity: sensor.robot_current_room, name: Room }
            - { entity: sensor.robot_battery, name: Battery }
            - { entity: sensor.robot_last_area, name: Last area }
            - { entity: sensor.robot_total_cleanings, name: Cleanings }
        - divider: true
          layout: row
          align: space-between
          show_name: false
          entities:
            - entity: sensor.robot_battery
              rules:
                - { below: 20, color: red, icon: mdi:battery-alert }
                - { above: 20, color: green, icon: mdi:battery }
            - entity: sensor.robot_dustbin_remaining
              icon: mdi:delete-outline
              rules:
                - { below: 20, color: red }
                - { above: 20, color: grey }
            - entity: vacuum.robot
              icon: mdi:play
              color: blue
              tap_action:
                action: perform-action
                perform_action: vacuum.start
                target: { entity_id: vacuum.robot }
            - entity: vacuum.robot
              icon: mdi:pause
              color: blue
              tap_action:
                action: perform-action
                perform_action: vacuum.pause
                target: { entity_id: vacuum.robot }
            - entity: vacuum.robot
              icon: mdi:home
              color: blue
              tap_action:
                action: perform-action
                perform_action: vacuum.return_to_base
                target: { entity_id: vacuum.robot }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card
      title: Washing machine
      icon: mdi:washing-machine
      sections:
        - layout: table
          entities:
            - entity: sensor.washer_status
              name: Status
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: run, color: green, label: Running }
                - { state: pause, color: amber, label: Paused }
                - { state: end, color: teal, label: Done, tint_card: true }
                - { state: power_off, color: grey, label: "Off" }
            - { entity: sensor.washer_status, name: Progress, attribute: progress, unit: "%" }
            - { entity: sensor.washer_remaining, name: Remaining }
            - { entity: sensor.power_consumption, name: Power, decimals: 0 }
        - divider: true
          entities:
            - entity: sensor.washer_status
              name: Progress
              icon: mdi:progress-clock
              color: green
              attribute: progress
              unit: "%"
              visual: bar
              min: 0
              max: 100
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card
      title: Kitchen window sensor
      icon: mdi:window-closed-variant
      sections:
        - layout: table
          show_icon: true
          entities:
            - entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen
              name: Contact
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
                - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
            - entity: sensor.kitchen_window_battery
              name: Battery
              visual: ring
              rules:
                - { below: 20, color: red }
                - { below: 50, color: amber }
                - { above: 50, color: green }
            - { entity: sensor.kitchen_temperature, name: Temperature, icon: mdi:thermometer, decimals: 1 }
        - divider: true
          layout: table
          align: start
          entities:
            - { entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen, name: Area, value: Kitchen }
            - { entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen, name: Type, value: Contact sensor }
            - { entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen, name: Brand, value: Aqara }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card
      title: Energy
      icon: mdi:lightning-bolt
      header_entities:
        - { entity: sensor.solar_power, color: amber, decimals: 0 }
      sections:
        - layout: table
          entities:
            - { entity: sensor.power_consumption, name: Consumption, decimals: 0 }
            - { entity: sensor.solar_power, name: Solar, decimals: 0 }
            - { entity: sensor.energy_today, name: Today, decimals: 1 }
            - { entity: sensor.dining_light_power, name: Dining light, decimals: 0 }
            - { entity: sensor.range_hood_power, name: Range hood, decimals: 0 }
        - divider: true
          layout: grid
          columns: 2
          entities:
            - { entity: sensor.solar_power, name: Solar, color: amber, decimals: 0, visual: columns }
            - { entity: sensor.power_consumption, name: Consumption, color: red, decimals: 0, visual: sparkline }
```
